@Test

" + "from (select "units_per_case", "cases_per_pallet",
" + "      "product_id", 1 as foo
" + "  from "product"
" + "  where "cases_per_pallet" > 100
" + "  union all
" + "  select "units_per_case", "cases_per_pallet",
" + "      "product_id", 1 as foo
" + "  from "product"
" + "  where "cases_per_pallet" < 100)
" + "where "cases_per_pallet" > 100
" + "group by "product_id", "units_per_case"
" + "order by "units_per_case" desc";
    final String expected = "SELECT COUNT(*), t3.units_per_case
" + "FROM (SELECT product.units_per_case, product.cases_per_pallet, " + "product.product_id, 1 AS FOO
" + "FROM foodmart.product AS product
" + "WHERE product.cases_per_pallet > 100
" + "UNION ALL
" + "SELECT product0.units_per_case, product0.cases_per_pallet, " + "product0.product_id, 1 AS FOO
" + "FROM foodmart.product AS product0
" + "WHERE product0.cases_per_pallet < 100) AS t3
" + "WHERE t3.cases_per_pallet > 100
" + "GROUP BY t3.product_id, t3.units_per_case
" + "ORDER BY t3.units_per_case DESC";
    sql(query).withDb2().ok(expected);
}

/** * Test case for * [CALCITE-5013] * Unparse SqlSetOperator should be retained parentheses * when the operand has limit or offset. */ @Test void testSetOpRetainParentheses() { // Parentheses will be discarded, because semantics not be affected. final String discardedParenthesesQuery = "SELECT "product_id" FROM "product"" + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" WHERE "product_id" > 10) " + "INTERSECT ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" )"; final String discardedParenthesesRes = "SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "UNION ALL " + "SELECT * " + "FROM (SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "WHERE "product_id" > 10 " + "INTERSECT ALL " + "SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product")"; sql(discardedParenthesesQuery).ok(discardedParenthesesRes); // Parentheses will be retained because sub-query has LIMIT or OFFSET. // If parentheses are discarded the semantics of parsing will be affected. final String allSetOpQuery = "SELECT "product_id" FROM "product"" + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" LIMIT 10) " + "INTERSECT ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" OFFSET 10) " + "EXCEPT ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" LIMIT 5 OFFSET 5)"; final String allSetOpRes = "SELECT * " + "FROM (SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "UNION ALL " + "SELECT * " + "FROM ((SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY) " + "INTERSECT ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "OFFSET 10 ROWS))) " + "EXCEPT ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "OFFSET 5 ROWS " + "FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY)"; sql(allSetOpQuery).ok(allSetOpRes); // After the config is enabled, order by will be retained, so parentheses are required. final String retainOrderQuery = "SELECT "product_id" FROM "product"" + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" ORDER BY "product_id")"; final String retainOrderResult = "SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "ORDER BY "product_id")"; sql(retainOrderQuery).withConfig(c -> c.withRemoveSortInSubQuery(false)).ok(retainOrderResult); // Parentheses are required to keep ORDER and LIMIT on the sub-query. final String retainLimitQuery = "SELECT "product_id" FROM "product"" + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 2)"; final String retainLimitResult = "SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "UNION ALL " + "(SELECT "product_id" " + "FROM "foodmart"."product" " + "ORDER BY "product_id" " + "FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY)"; sql(retainLimitQuery).ok(retainLimitResult); }
